policies.name: RF-Service-Not-Available
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<RaiseFault async="false" continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="RF-Service-Not-Available">
    <DisplayName>RF-Service-Not-Available</DisplayName>
    <FaultResponse>
    <Set>
      <Payload contentType="application/json" variablePrefix="@" variableSuffix="#">
                {
    "Error": "Infath service resource is unavailable",
    "ServicePath": "@proxy.basepath#@proxy.pathsuffix#",
    "host": "@request.header.Host#",
    "apigeeDetails": {
        <!-- "organization": "@organization.name#", -->
        "environment": "@environment.name#",
        "proxy": "@apiproxy.name#",
        "revision": "@apiproxy.revision#"
    },
    "message": "Please verify the requested service path or contact Infath support"
}
            </Payload>
      <StatusCode>404</StatusCode>
      <ReasonPhrase>Resource Not Avialable</ReasonPhrase>
    </Set>
  </FaultResponse>
  <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>true</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
</RaiseFault>
